title: golden-parity SHAPE GEOMETRY hard-fail: 3 DefineShape records unmatched (regression)
description:
REGRESSION (HARD dimension fail). `node tools/golden-parity.mjs` exits 1 on SHAPE GEOMETRY: 3 of our DefineShape records have no record-signature match in golden.swf.

EXPECTED: exit 0, all hard dimensions PASS (SHAPE GEOMETRY = KNOWN-GAP for the gradient fill-count expansion only). The harness-intro commit 7186f68 (Jun 13) message explicitly states 'SHAPE GEOMETRY (records + ShapeBounds)... All hard dimensions PASS on golden'.
ACTUAL: exit 1, SHAPE GEOMETRY = DIFF.

UNMATCHED SHAPES (bounds match golden exactly; only the edge-record SIGNATURE differs):
  ours id3 fills=1 nrec=18 bounds ±220   vs golden id1 nrec=9  (the r=210 twip circle, fill #FFCC00 + 20twip stroke)
  ours id1 fills=1 nrec=10 bounds ±545   vs golden id8 nrec=5  (the r=535 twip circle/square, fill #FF0000 + 20twip stroke)
  ours id8 fills=1 nrec=9  bounds -1229..1231,-458..442 vs golden id5 fills=17 nrec=9 (the logo; fills=17 is the documented gradient-expansion KNOWN-GAP, but its signature still mismatches)

REGRESSION VERDICT + INTRODUCING SHA:
  Bisected (rebuild core+swf dist per commit; golden-parity recompiles in JS). 
  035796d^ -> SHAPE GEOMETRY KNOWN-GAP, exit 0 (PASS).
  035796d   -> SHAPE GEOMETRY DIFF, exit 1 (same 3-shape diff as HEAD).
  INTRODUCED BY: 035796d 'fix(fla-import): reconstruct closed fill loops from fill0/fill1 edge model' (packages/core/src/fla/flash8-import.ts convertShape).

ROOT-CAUSE HYPOTHESIS:
  035796d rewrote convertShape to emit fills and strokes as SEPARATE closed paths (see the CLAUDE.md 'Shape fills use the SWF fill0/fill1 edge model' learning). For a shape that has BOTH a fill style AND a line style (the two circles each have fill + a 20twip black stroke), our encoder now emits the loop TWICE — once as a fill-only loop, once as a stroke-only loop — so the DefineShape record stream has ~2x golden's edge records (18 vs 9, 10 vs 5). swf-dump confirms ours duplicates the entire moveTo/curveTo loop; golden emits ONE loop carrying BOTH fillStyle1=1 and a lineStyle (Flash's combined fill+stroke single-loop encoding). The signature (sequence of edge-record type:x,y) therefore never matches even though the GEOMETRY and ShapeBounds are byte-identical. This is renderer-correct (the two-pass renderer draws fills then strokes) but breaks Flash byte/structure parity.

  SECONDARY (not the signature breaker, separate fidelity bug worth noting): the imported line cap/join is wrong — ours endCap=None joinStyle=Bevel vs golden endCap=Round joinStyle=Round startCap=Round on the same strokes. convertShape/flash8-binary is dropping the FLA's round caps/joins and defaulting to None/Bevel.

FIX DIRECTION (for the implementer to evaluate): when a shape region has both a fill and a coincident stroke on the same closed loop, emit a SINGLE shape record carrying fillStyle1 + lineStyle on that loop (matching Flash) instead of two duplicate loops — OR teach the parity harness's shape-signature matcher that a fill-loop + identical stroke-loop pair is equivalent to one combined loop. The former restores true structural parity; the latter only quiets the harness. Also restore round cap/join on import. Confirm convertShape's separate-paths split does not regress the traced-bitmap shapes (Magnet.fla) it was written for.

REPRO:
  export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"
  node tools/golden-parity.mjs   # exits 1; SHAPE GEOMETRY DIFF
  (requires tools/swf-dump built — see docs/qa/golden-parity-setup.md)

Inspector used to map the 3 shapes: dumped both SWFs via tools/swf-dump and compared DefineShape records/fillStyles/lineStyles (logged ours-vs-golden record sequences).
